scenario: A rural clinic has one portable oxygen unit and two patients, Eli and Noor. The unit cannot be divided, and no replacement can arrive in time. Under the first available action, the clinician gives the oxygen unit to Eli; Eli receives oxygen and avoids respiratory injury, while Noor receives no oxygen and suffers respiratory injury. Under the second available action, the clinician gives the oxygen unit to Noor; Noor receives oxygen and avoids respiratory injury, while Eli receives no oxygen and suffers respiratory injury. The clinician must select one of these two actions.
